CVS Health is a healthcare company focused on creating a more connected, convenient, and compassionate health experience. The Software Development Engineer will design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications and data-driven business solutions, including responsive interfaces and RESTful APIs using Python and TypeScript. The role also supports system integration, observability, testing, code reviews, and deployments while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Supports application observability through logging, alerting, and performance monitoring
